# Set-ZbxUserDirectory

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a user directory.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxUserDirectory [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixUserDirectory>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-IdpType <ZabbixIdpType>] [-ProvisionStatus <bool>] [-Description <string>] [-LdapHost <string>] [-Port <string>] [-BaseDN <string>] [-BindDN <string>] [-BindPassword <SecureString>] [-SearchAttribute <string>] [-StartTls <bool>] [-SearchFilter <string>] [-GroupBaseDN <string>] [-UserReferenceAttribute <string>] [-GroupName <string>] [-UserUserName <string>] [-UserLastName <string>] [-GroupMember <string>] [-GroupFilter <string>] [-GroupMembership <string>] [-IdpEntityId <string>] [-SsoUrl <string>] [-SloUrl <string>] [-SPEntityId <string>] [-NameIdFormat <string>] [-UserNameAttribute <string>] [-SignMessages <bool>] [-SignAssertions <bool>] [-SignAuthnRequests <bool>] [-SignLogoutRequests <bool>] [-SignLogoutResponses <bool>] [-EncryptNameId <bool>] [-EncryptAssertions <bool>] [-ScimStatus <bool>] [-ProvisionGroup <ZabbixUserDirectoryProvisionGroupRequest[]>] [-ProvisionMedia <ZabbixUserDirectoryUpdateProvisionMediaRequest[]>] [-IdpCertificate <string>] [-SPCertificate <string>] [-SPPrivateKey <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A user directory is an LDAP server or a SAML identity provider that users authenticate against and, with provisioning, are created from. The Set-ZbxUserDirectory cmdlet changes the user directories given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with userdirectory.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every user directory the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed user directories back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a user directory

```powershell
Set-ZbxUserDirectory -InputObject 'Corporate LDAP' -Port '636'
```

Moves the user directory Corporate LDAP to port 636.

### Example 2: Change a user directory and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxUserDirectory -InputObject 'Corporate LDAP' -Port '636' -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the user directory Corporate LDAP back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.
